rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for an action done without conscious thought.

example.english: I involuntarily nodded along to the song.
example.traditional: 我唔自覺咁跟住首歌點頭。
example.jyutping: ngo5 m4 zi6 gok3 gam3 gan1 zyu6 sau2 go1 dim2 tau4

rows.note: Use this when the person cannot control a bodily movement or emotional reaction.

example.english: When I saw the dog barking so loudly, I involuntarily stepped back.
example.traditional: 我一見到隻狗咁大聲吠，就不由自主咁退後。
example.jyutping: ngo5 jat1 gin3 dou2 zek3 gau2 gam3 daai6 seng1 fai6 zau6 bat1 jau4 zi6 zyu2 gam3 teoi3 hau6

rows.note: Use this when something happens unintentionally or without the speaker noticing it.

example.english: I involuntarily pressed the wrong button.
example.traditional: 我唔覺意咁撳錯咗個掣。
example.jyutping: ngo5 m4 gok3 ji3 gam3 gam6 co3 zo2 go3 zai3

rows.note: Use this for an action caused by an irresistible urge, especially laughing, crying, or speaking.

example.jyutping: ngo5 jan2 m4 zyu6 siu3 zo2 ceot1 seng1
